contentPattern: One row per question, 2 cells: [question text (plain paragraph or h3)] | [answer paragraphs or lists, inline links preserved]. Rendered as native details/summary items, all collapsed by default, chevron on the right. A single-cell row is a question with no answer. 6 rows (patient) and 4 rows (HCP) on the source; the section carries Section Metadata Tab and Id (faq, faq-1) and an h2 'Frequently Asked Questions' as default content.
